kebab_example: aliyun rtc modify-app-agent-template --app-id ac7N0000 --id 1231231312312131231 --name '智能体模版' --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyAppAgentTemplate

parameters.help_en: The application ID. You can obtain this ID from the console. Only one ID can be specified
parameters.help_zh: 应用ID。通过控制台创建和查询，仅支持传单个ID
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_zh:
智能体类型：
1: 语音通话（默认）
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The chat mode:

`1`: Natural conversation mode (default)

`2`: Walkie-talkie mode
parameters.help_zh:
对话模式：
1: 自然对话模式（默认）
2: 对讲机模式
parameters.name: chat_mode

parameters.help_en:
The interrupt mode:

`1`: Allow interrupt (default)

`2`: Disable interrupt
parameters.help_zh:
打断方式：
1: 支持打断（默认）
2: 禁止打断
parameters.name: interrupt_mode

parameters.help_en: The greeting message. The maximum length is 500 characters
parameters.help_zh: 问候语，最大长度不超过500
parameters.name: greeting

fields.help_en: The threshold for sentence-end detection, in milliseconds (ms). The value must be from 200 to 6,000. Default: 500
fields.help_zh: 语音断句检测阈值，默认500ms，允许范围[200，6000]
fields.name: max_sentence_silence

fields.help_en: The name
fields.help_zh: 名称
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: The minimum duration of continuous human speech, in milliseconds (ms), required to trigger an interrupt. This helps prevent false interruptions. The value must be from 0 to 3,000. Default: 300
fields.help_zh: 人声持续阈值 (ms)，取值范围为[0,3000]。持续检测到人声信号的最小时间长度，避免误打断。默认300ms
fields.name: interrupt_speech_duration

fields.help_en: VAD (Voice Activity Detection) configuration
fields.help_zh: vad配置
fields.name: vad_config

fields.help_en: The hotword vocabulary ID
fields.help_zh: 热词ID
fields.name: vocabulary_id

fields.help_en:
The language code. This parameter is optional, as the LLM automatically detects the language.

`zh`: Chinese

`en`: English
fields.help_zh:
语言代码。可不写，大模型会自动设别。
zh: 中文
en: 英文
fields.name: lang

fields.help_en: The weight of the hotword, which must be an integer from 1 to 5. The recommended value is 4. If the effect is not noticeable, you can increase the weight. However, a high weight may negatively impact the recognition accuracy of other words
fields.help_zh:
热词权重，取值范围为[1, 5]之间的整数。
常用值：4。
如果效果不明显可以适当增加权重，但是当权重较大时可能会引起负面效果，导致其他词语识别不准确
fields.name: weight

fields.help_en: The hotword. The maximum length is 10 characters
fields.help_zh: 热词文本，每个词语最长10个汉字或英文单词
fields.name: word

fields.help_en: Each vocabulary can contain up to 500 hotwords, and each hotword cannot exceed 10 characters. Hotwords must be UTF-8 encoded and must not contain punctuation or special characters. The system ignores hotwords that do not meet these requirements
fields.help_zh:
每个词表最多包含500个热词，每个热词中文长度不超过10个字符。
热词必须为UTF-8编码，不能包含标点、特殊字符，不符合的情况下，无热词效果
fields.name: word_weights

fields.help_en: The Model Studio Agent ID
fields.help_zh: 百炼智能体ID
fields.name: agent_app_id

fields.help_en: The API key required by the LLM vendor
fields.help_zh: 大模型服务商需要的apikey
fields.name: api_key

fields.help_en: The number of historical conversation turns provided to the LLM. Maximum: 100. Default: 50
fields.help_zh: 给大模型提供多少历史对话轮次，最大100，默认值50
fields.name: history_depth

fields.help_en: The maximum number of tokens in the output text. Default: 8192
fields.help_zh: 输出文本的最大限制，默认值8192
fields.name: max_token

fields.help_en: The name
fields.help_zh: 名称
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: The prompt for the LLM. The maximum length is 5,000 characters
fields.help_zh: 大模型提示词，最大长度为5000
fields.name: prompt

fields.help_en: The sampling temperature. The value must be in the range [0, 2). Default: 0.7
fields.help_zh: 采样温度，取值范围[0,2)，默认值0.7
fields.name: temperature

fields.help_en: The nucleus sampling (top-p) threshold. The value must be in the range (0, 1]. Default: 0.8
fields.help_zh: 采样的选择范围(0,1]，默认值0.8
fields.name: topp

fields.help_en: The endpoint for a third-party LLM
fields.help_zh: 接入第三方大模型时，该字段表示接入的endpoint
fields.name: url

fields.help_en: The LLM vendor. Supported values are `aliyun` for Alibaba Cloud Model Studio and `thirdparty` for vendors with an OpenAI-compatible API
fields.help_zh: 提供方，目前支持阿里云-百炼和第三方配置（符合OpenAI接口规范）
fields.name: vendor

fields.help_en: The API key required by the service vendor
fields.help_zh: 大模型服务商需要的apikey
fields.name: api_key

fields.help_en:
The filter settings for removing brackets from the text before TTS synthesis.

`1`: Full-width parentheses `（）`

`2`: Half-width parentheses `()`

`3`: Full-width square brackets `【】`

`4`: Half-width square brackets `[]`

`5`: Half-width curly braces `{}`
fields.help_zh:
过滤设置。
1-中文刮号（）
2-英文刮号()
3-中文方刮号【】
4-英文方刮号[]
5-英文花刮号{}
fields.name: filter_brackets

fields.help_en: The name
fields.help_zh: 名称
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: The pitch. The value must be from 0.5 to 2.0. Default: 1.0
fields.name: pitch

fields.help_en: The speech rate. The value must be from 0.5 to 2.0. Default: 1.0
fields.name: rate

fields.help_en: The TTS vendor. Currently, only Alibaba Cloud is supported
fields.help_zh: 提供方，目前支持阿里云-百炼
fields.name: vendor

fields.help_en: The volume. The value must be from 0 to 100. Default: 50
fields.help_zh: 音量，取值范围[0~100]，默认50
fields.name: volume

fields.help_en: The timeout for a silence alert, in seconds. This alert can be triggered multiple times; if the agent is still silent after a timeout, the alert is triggered again. The value must be from 5 to 600. A value of 0 (the default) disables this feature
fields.help_zh:
静默提醒的超时时间（单位：秒）。
可能多次触发，若智能体静默提醒超时后依然静默，则再超时还会继续触发，取值范围：[5, 600]，默认值0，0表示不提醒
fields.name: alert_timeout

fields.help_en: The content of the silence prompt message
fields.help_zh: 静默提示消息的内容
fields.name: content

fields.help_en: The strategy for handling a silence timeout. Default: `1`
fields.help_zh:
静默超时处理策略。
1 - 向用户语音播报content指定的提示消息
2 - 把content指定的提示消息和历史对话发送给LLM，并播报模型生成的回复
默认值：1
fields.name: strategy

fields.help_en: The timeout for triggering an agent silence webhook, in seconds. This can be triggered multiple times; if the agent is still silent after a timeout, the webhook is triggered again. The value must be from 10 to 600. A value of 0 (the default) disables this feature
fields.help_zh: 触发智能体静默超时webhook的静默超时时间（单位：秒）。可能多次触发，若智能体webhook静默超时后依然静默，则再超时还会继续触发，取值范围：[10, 600]，默认值0，0表示不触发
fields.name: webhook_trigger_timeout

fields.help_en: The ID of the ambient sound. The following default sounds are provided by the agent:
fields.help_zh:
agent提供以下默认环境音：
    - white_noise 
    - office
fields.name: sound_id

fields.help_en: The volume level
fields.help_zh: 音量大小
fields.name: volume

parameters.help_en: Configuration for the agent's ambient sound. If this parameter is not specified, ambient sound is disabled
parameters.help_zh: 智能体环境音配置。不传表示不使用环境配置
parameters.name: ambient_sound_config

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable semantic interrupt
fields.help_zh: 按语义打断
fields.name: semantics_interrupt

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable backchanneling
fields.help_zh: 是否开启承接词
fields.name: user_turn_end

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable video understanding. If enabled, the specified LLM must support multimodal data
parameters.help_zh: 如果开启，LLM模型必须支持多模态数据
parameters.name: enable_video_understanding

parameters.help_en:
When `EnableVideoUnderstanding` is `true`, this parameter specifies which video stream to prioritize if both a camera stream and a screen sharing stream are being published. The agent can only process one stream at a time.

`1`: Prioritize the camera stream (Default)

`2`: Prioritize the screen sharing stream
parameters.help_zh:
开启视觉理解后，可以设置智能体优先理解的视频流。
智能体只能理解一路视频流，当Camera流和屏幕共享流同时推流

1 - 智能体优先理解Camera流；

2 - 智能体优先理解屏幕共享流；

默认优先理解Camera流
parameters.name: prefer_video
